item: thin(): algorithm and parameters
decision: Buffer each point by thinDist (sf::st_buffer, default segments), find intersecting points; repeatedly remove the point with most neighbours (ties random) until none has a neighbour; repeat for 5 runs (set.seed(i), i in a random permutation of 1:5) and keep a run with the most points (ties random). Faster rewrite (2026-11-03) proven identical to the old version on 16 cases + random sets.

item: thin() reproducibility (seeds)
